한 타석은 볼카운트 0볼 0스트라이크에서 시작한다. 투구 결과는 볼, 스: A plate appearance starts at a count of 0 balls 0 strikes. A pitch result is one of ball, strike, swinging strike, foul, groundout, or hit. A ball is one ball. A strike and a swinging strike are each one strike. A foul always counts as one strike. When the balls reach four, the plate appearance ends in a walk, and when the strikes reach three, the plate appearance ends in a strikeout. If a groundout or a hit occurs, the plate appearance has ended by hitting the ball.

A strike and a swinging strike are each one strike. A foul counts as one strike only when there are 0 or 1 strikes, and when there are 2 strikes the count does not change. When the balls reach four, the plate appearance ends in a walk, and when the strikes reach three, the plate appearance ends in a strikeout. If a groundout or a hit occurs, the plate appearance has ended by hitting the ball.
